content:
Claude is upgrading the Chrome sidebar into a full Cowork session, allowing users' work and conversations in the browser to seamlessly continue into Claude's other applications.

Browser-based work can now continue across all Claude applications

Anthropic announced the change today. Conversations initiated from the sidebar are now saved to Claude's conversation history, enabling users to continue them in Claude's desktop, web, and mobile apps.

Configured account Skills and connectors can be used directly in the browser with no additional setup required. Claude in Chrome can read the current page and perform actions through the user's existing logged-in browser session, including clicking links, switching pages, entering text, and filling out forms.

Anthropic gives the example: users can ask Claude to gather invoice data from multiple vendor websites, create a spreadsheet, and then continue the same session on desktop to add local files or compare the results with budgets from previous years.

This update fills a gap in Claude's browser workflow. Previously, sidebar sessions and conversations in Claude's other applications were completely independent, with no way to carry content or context between them.

Anthropic previously introduced an in-app browser in Claude Code, which uses a separate profile. By contrast, the Chrome extension operates directly on sites where users are already logged in.

Anthropic reminds users that browser agents remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks.

In auto-approve mode, the system applies additional review for higher-impact actions; for activities involving purchases or sharing personal data, Claude still confirms with the user first.

The company says these measures reduce risk but cannot eliminate it entirely.

Availability

The Cowork sidebar is available to Max and Team customers starting today, and will be rolled out to Pro users in phases over the coming weeks. Enterprise admins can enable the feature and restrict access to approved domains. Claude in Chrome is not yet supported on other Chromium browsers or mobile devices.

This release is part of Anthropic's ongoing effort to make Claude workflows seamlessly span across platforms.

Recent additions include real-time iOS app previews in Claude Code for Mac, and new action options in Opus 4.8 to support longer-running work across more products and devices.
